title: Comic Book Artist Portfolio
description: Gives editors and publishers one professional place to review the artist's work and discuss a commission.
constraints: Editors needed to review work quickly without digging through social posts or scattered files.
problem: The artist's work was scattered across social media. Without a professional portfolio site, editors and publishers had no single place to review it.
solution: Built a fast, clean portfolio site that lets the artwork lead. The galleries follow how editors review work, so sequential pages, covers, and character pieces are easy to scan and compare.
result: The site gives editors a clean way to review the work and reach out for commissions without asking for links or files first.
